en: Sepia-toned image of an old European courtyard framed by high plastered stone walls with rectangular windows. Ivy and climbing plants cover much of the walls and an arched passageway. A small curved stairway leads up to a door on the left, while an inner pointed archway with a sculpted element above it opens into a shaded passage under the building. The roof is steeply pitched with small dormers, typical of historic Central European architecture. There is no visible printed caption on the front.
